summary: Bilateral pulmonary edema and pleural effusions have decreased, with residual left basilar opacity.

findings.rationale: The prior bilateral perihilar/lower-lung hazy airspace-interstitial opacity is less extensive on the current image, though low-volume portable technique and residual left basilar opacity remain.
Small bilateral pleural effusions are reduced compared with the prior image, especially at the lung bases, although a left basilar effusion/atelectatic veil persists.
